name: Horizontal Gallery
description: Full-screen horizontal scroll gallery of image cards with caption labels, where the background color shifts to match the card most in view and a counter tracks position.
contents: Row of image cards with title and description captions
behavior: Native horizontal scrolling with smooth scroll, scrollbar hidden
IntersectionObserver picks the most visible card and fades the background to its color

Counter and drag cue visibility and label
